name: socialmedia
description: Socially application with React client and Express server

scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
